title: tillandsia amoena
intro: Tillandsia amoena, commonly known as the "Purple Poppy Tillandsia" or "Purple Velvet Air Plant," is a species of epiphytic bromeliad, a type of air plant that obtains moisture and nutrients from the air rather than through a root system. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate anxiety due to its therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Tillandsia amoena include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Tillandsia amoena include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
